description_en: Retrieves playback records based on the player's TraceId. This API supports pagination
description_zh: 通过播放器TraceId来获取播放记录列表，该接口有分页
kebab_example: aliyun ice describe-play-list --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --trace-id 0bc5e70516766285805381012d271e --begin-ts 1676170500011 --end-ts 1682474405173 --order-type DESC --order-name FirstFrameDuration --play-type vod --status complete --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePlayList

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. By default, the system queries data of the current day.
parameters.description_zh: 开始时间，默认查询当天的时间。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. By default, the system queries data of the current day
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，默认查询当天的时间

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The time range cannot exceed 24 hours.
